title.zh: 社区提案到生产投产的四象限组合优先级矩阵（THR1022 官方模型）

subtitle.zh: 横轴衡量工程复杂度、跨系统编排与变革投入，纵轴衡量业务结果影响与证据兑现速度
subtitle.en: X-axis: Engineering & Change Effort · Y-axis: Measurable Business Outcome Impact

xAxis.zh: 工程实施与组织变革投入度（Low Effort → High Effort）
xAxis.en: Engineering Implementation & Change Effort (Low Effort → High Effort)

yAxis.zh: 可衡量业务价值与财务影响（Low Impact → High Impact）
yAxis.en: Measurable Business Value & Financial Impact (Low Impact → High Impact)

topLeft.zh: 速赢组合（Quick Win：资助 3–5 项）

topRight.zh: 战略投资（Strategic Investment：资助 1–2 项）

bottomLeft.zh: 探索试验（Explore：先消解关键不确定性）

bottomRight.zh: 审慎重估（Reconsider：简化、合并或叫停）

label.zh: 速赢标杆：每周高频断裂流端到端闭环
label.en: Quick Win: Weekly End-to-End Broken Workflow

detail.zh: 资助 3–5 项；周频重复、指标清晰且含 CFO/一线双赢场景，快速建立基线证明价值
detail.en: Fund 3–5; weekly volume, clear baseline, rapid proof for both executives & staff

label.zh: 战略投资：跨部门核心流程重构

detail.zh: 资助 1–2 项；高投入高回报，严格绑定阶段门禁（Stage Gates）与里程碑证据
detail.en: Fund 1–2; high effort & impact, governed by stage gates and evidence milestones

label.zh: 探索陷阱：脱离真实痛点的“10 个点子”或单季度低频需求
label.en: Explore Trap: Generic '10 Agent Ideas' or Quarterly Task

detail.zh: 如索要“4 个 Autopilot”或每季仅用一次；先澄清真实工作流痛点，暂不批复投产预算
detail.en: E.g., asking for 4 Autopilots or quarterly tasks; resolve workflow fit before funding

label.zh: 重估叫停：遗留手工尾巴的高成本碎片化试点
label.en: Reconsider: High-Effort Fragment Leaving Last 2 Steps Manual

detail.zh: 跨多套工具却未打通最后两步，无基线无责任人；果断简化合并、延期或终止
detail.en: Automates middle steps across tools but leaves manual tail; simplify, defer, or stop
